# @allons-y/webc-oss-site

> The Allons-y Studio theme for Norn sites: brand tokens and rules, self-hosted fonts, and the locked `oss-bar`, `oss-cta`, `oss-credit`, and `oss-head` components. Use it only for Allons-y Studio open source sites. Everything generic lives in `@allons-y/webc-patterns`; read its `llms.txt` first. The reference at the end is generated from the component sources.

## What you are working with

- A plugin, `@allons-y/webc-oss-site`, that you add in place of the Norn plugin with the same options. It adds the Norn plugin, fills the four hooks (`head`, `banner`, `cta`, `credit`), embeds the brand tokens and rules, sets the theme color and locale, and copies the fonts to `assets/fonts`.
- `ossProps(site, project, { docs, anchors, oss })`: maps the site facts and `project.json` to layout props with the theme's English link set (header links, Docs, GitHub, npm, footer groups, conduct and security policies).
- The components are hook fills. A page does not call them.

## Rules

- **Never add the Norn plugin as well.** The OSS plugin adds it, and a second registration fails the build.
- **`oss-bar`, `oss-cta`, `oss-credit` are locked.** A project file with one of those names fails the build. A project opts out of the whole studio layer with `"oss-docs": { "oss": false }` in `package.json`. Do not edit, copy, or hide them with CSS.
- The brand lives in the `norn.oss` layer: `css/tokens.css` sets the mono font token and `css/brand.css` styles the header strip and footer name with rules on the component tags. To change the look, override global tokens in the project's own stylesheet. Components have no theme hooks.
- Project-specific head markup goes through `fillHooks(config, { head: "…" })` from `@allons-y/webc-patterns/plugin`. The project's fills append after the theme's.
- Item data uses `href`, `title`, `description` like every Norn layout. `ossProps` returns it that way, and the `docs` you pass in must too.
- Site data comes from the patterns package's builders (`buildSite`, with `host` from this package). The `fixtures/landing`, `fixtures/docs`, and `fixtures/workspaces` folders are complete working projects.
- The package needs network access once at pack time to inline the org's SVGs. Set `OSS_ASSETS` to a local `assets` folder to pack offline.

## Where to look next

- README: the full plugin example, `ossProps`, the components table.
- Component preview: https://allonsy-studio.github.io/webc-resources/

## Reference

Generated from the component sources and their CSF files. Do not edit by hand: run `yarn llms`.

### Container components

A bounded surface that holds content: a card, a card grid, a section, a hero.

#### oss-cta

Tag: `<oss-cta>`.

OSS call to action, at the foot of the page. Locked: its copy and actions are fixed, and it takes no slots. The one setting is the heading level. Closes the page body, above the footer: the `cta` hook places it last. The Allons-y Studio name is signed in the signature face, Yellowtail, which `oss-head` declares. Its actions are `norn-link-button`s, colored by setting the global accent tokens on `oss-cta`. The one place Allons-y Studio's contact address appears. The mark is inlined from the org's assets by `scripts/inline-svg.js`.

Props:

- `level` (number, optional, default `2`, one of `2`, `3`, `4`): The heading level, to fit the page outline. Any other value gives the default.

Global tokens it reads: `--norn-ui-border-radius`, `--norn-space-s`, `--norn-space-m`, `--norn-space-l`, `--norn-space-xl`.

### Component components

A self-contained element: a link, a code block, a lockup.

#### oss-bar

Tag: `<oss-bar>`.

OSS banner, shown before the page's header. Locked: it takes no props or slots. The SVG is inlined from the org's assets by `scripts/inline-svg.js`, cropped to the lockup. It shows at full size from 31.25rem up and scales down below that, so the text stays readable on a phone and grows with the text size.

#### oss-credit

Tag: `<oss-credit>`.

OSS credit lockup for the footer, light or dark by the scheme the page uses. Locked: it takes no props or slots. One SVG, inlined from the org's light and dark assets by `scripts/inline-svg.js` and cropped to the art. The two assets differ only in paint, so the script merges them: each changed `fill` and `stroke` reads `light-dark(light, dark)`, which follows the page's `color-scheme`, set by the visitor's preference or by CSS.

### Document components

The head and the foundation styles, with no body markup.

#### oss-head

Tag: `<oss-head>`.

The OSS site head: the PT Mono preload and the self-hosted `@font-face` rules for PT Mono, Instrument Sans, and Yellowtail, each with a fallback matched to its metrics. The OSS site plugin puts it in `norn-base`'s head hook, followed by the brand tokens from `css/tokens.css`. Call it elsewhere as `<meta webc:is="oss-head" webc:nokeep />`. The `@font-face` rules look for the fonts at `assets/fonts`, one level up from the bundle: the OSS site plugin copies the package's `fonts` folder there. The brand tokens it goes with, in `css/tokens.css` and the `norn.oss` layer, are below. The brand rules in `css/brand.css` follow them in the same layer, such as the four-color strip along the header bar and the footer's project name in the accent color and the mono face, at 1.2rem. A project's unlayered CSS still wins over both.
